patch_list: Hides the Search tab from the bottom bar.
Signs in with an App Check token. Get one from the token bot, or copy it from Yuka installed from Google Play on a rooted phone. Steps are in the Yuka section of PATCHES.md.
Unlocks food preferences, diet alerts and the full history. Search and offline downloads don't work. Signing in needs Sign-in token, except on a root mount install.
